bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating sentence-level bias using Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) variants (tests 6, 7, and 8) and assessing bias propagation in a downstream Natural Language Inference (MNLI) task by measuring entailment neutrality metrics (Net Neutral, Fraction Neutral, and Threshold). The paper also visualizes gender bias by computing the cosine similarity between the hidden states of stereotypical words and feminine/masculine dimension vectors.
